- 所以人们都知道，那红灵芝对身体好处：这样，有好处

The system's item in each run:

Run 2: 对身体好处：对身体有好处，The expression requires “有”: “对身体有好处” means beneficial to the body. [vocab list]
Run 3: 对身体好处：对身体有好处，The expression for being beneficial to the body is 对身体有好处; 好处 needs 有 in this predicate pattern. [vocab list]
